core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nasib is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Share, portion, lot”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nasib corresponds to the Arabic form نَصِيب (Arabic root ن ص ب (n-ṣ-b); نَصِيب (Naṣīb)). Its core sense is share, portion, lot. Nasib is Arabic نَصِيب (Naṣīb) 'share, portion, lot', from the root ن ص ب (n-ṣ-b). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave ناصب (a different form); the correct form is نَصِيب. The source gloss 'Fate, Destiny' is broadly consistent. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source labelled the gender unisex; documented usage is predominantly male. Same name as naseeb.

persian.name: نصیب
